headline.en: Prospect Ridge closes second real estate credit fund at $800 million
headline.zh: Prospect Ridge 第二只房地产信贷基金完成募集，规模 8 亿美元

summary.en: Prospect Ridge closed its second commercial real estate credit fund with $800 million in capital commitments, the firm announced. The fund, Prospect Ridge Real Estate Debt Fund II, has roughly $3 billion of total lending capacity and will make first-mortgage loans, mezzanine loans and preferred equity investments across the U.S. It follows the firm's debut $500 million fund focused on transitional and value-add opportunities.
summary.zh: Prospect Ridge 宣布其第二只商业房地产信贷基金完成募集，获得 8 亿美元资本承诺。该基金 Prospect Ridge Real Estate Debt Fund II 总放贷能力约 30 亿美元，将在美国各地进行第一抵押贷款、夹层贷款和优先股投资。此前该公司的首只基金规模为 5 亿美元，主要关注过渡性和增值型机会。

headline.en: Pallas Capital secures £200m senior credit line from European debt fund
headline.zh: Pallas Capital 从一家欧洲债务基金获得 2 亿英镑高级信贷额度

summary.en: UK bridging lender Pallas Capital has secured a £200m senior funding line from a European debt fund. The facility will help Pallas commit financing across its UK product range, spanning residential, mixed-use and commercial lending.
summary.zh: 英国过桥贷款机构 Pallas Capital 从一家欧洲债务基金获得 2 亿英镑高级融资额度。该额度将帮助 Pallas 在其英国产品范围内继续提供融资，涵盖住宅、混合用途和商业贷款。

headline.en: LACERA appoints Cheyne Capital to manage $750m credit mandate
headline.zh: LACERA委任Cheyne Capital管理7.5亿美元信贷授权

summary.en: The Los Angeles County Employees' Retirement Association (LACERA) has appointed Cheyne Capital Management to oversee a multi-asset credit mandate. The pension fund approved an investment of up to $750m in a Cheyne Capital multi-asset credit strategy through a dedicated managed account.
summary.zh: 洛杉矶县雇员退休协会（LACERA）已委任Cheyne Capital Management管理一项多资产信贷授权。该养老基金批准向Cheyne Capital通过专用管理账户运作的多资产信贷策略投资最多7.5亿美元。
